profiles.wall_rule: Independently authored cavity; no constant normal wall claim. Crown intentionally thickened.

unselected_usb_nose_continuous_straight_.motion: Exact union of the8mm nose translated12mm along+Y; not actual mating travel.

sequence: Empty shell: slide M4 nut into handle, key shoulder into crown, insert washer/screw and tighten from mouth.
Empty shell: radially side-load the three roofed M2 nut pockets from cavity; no cartridge present.
Outside shell: load body M2 nuts, speaker first, then retained yoke and two M2x6 screws.
Side-load yoke nuts, lower PCBA through open-top USB carrier, add empty cradle and two M2x6 screws.
Evaluate only an inert cell; side-load cover nuts, fit retained capture cover and two M2x6 screws.
Unplug first; align integral port bezel with mouth-open shell channel; insert complete captured cartridge.
Fit three recessed front M2x8 screws. Reverse for service; shell/handle load path stays independent of PCB.

shell_cartridge_joints.previous_defect: Parent visual review found nut/service pocket exterior breakthrough at R29.5. Static nonintersection alone was insufficient.
shell_cartridge_joints.hex_flat_orientation: Nut and pocket rotated angle+30 degrees; radial flats keep outer reach bounded.
shell_cartridge_joints.screw: Three M2x8; under-head z2.3, tip z10.3, nut seated on actual pocket floor z7.0, full1.6mm nut-body coverage, tip1.7mm beyond nut.
shell_cartridge_joints.proof_scope: Each actual nut-pocket, inward slot and screw-bore primitive expanded positively by1mm remains inside the unchanged outer solid and away from USB. Dilation distributes over their union. Expanded original cavity is likewise contained throughout the joint band. The actual shell retains all original revolved cosmetic side faces except the intended USB channel. Interior nut entry/front screw access intentionally open; not print-strength or manufacturing-tolerance qualification.

back_silk_visibility.scope: Mechanical screen only; no PCB edited and no active routing source read. Proposed text envelopes, not actual font/glyph bounds.
back_silk_visibility.view: Cartridge outside shell, cover removed, cell and contact metal still installed; look mouthward along -Z.
back_silk_visibility.rectangle_basis: 4.4x1.4mm for four-character polarity labels;12x1.4mm for T8 BUTTON END >. Electrical must fit actual mirrored B.SilkS glyph extents within the accepted rectangle.

exact_manifest_record.source: X6 conservative body/drill projection plus 0.5 mm per edge; secondary-anchor solder remains unqualified

1.note: Reservation only; real through-board tails remain unmeasured. Not an all-front BOM exclusion.

contact_retention.geometry: Unchanged frozen T8 yoke/cradle and actual thin contacts translated +10.75 mm; cover has straight upper-spring service channels with added exterior stock.

inherited_constructive_guard_stock_evide.note: Each ACTUAL pocket is positively offset by the tested wall radius and the full resulting BRep is contained in its own stock. Every stock is contained in global stock; global pocket equals the proved pocket union. Dilation distributes over union, so closed-stock wall is at least the tested radius. This avoids OCC's unsupported nested-shell extrema operation without substituting a bounding-box distance. Before intentional PCB landing/fastener reliefs; no clipping to bell shell.

contact_retention.wall_proof_scope: Unchanged cradle/local guard evidence; historical shell margins do not apply. Cover end-pocket modification is separately witnessed below.

cover_service_channels.reason: Old cover withdrawal check excluded contact metal; full thin spring tips obstructed rigid removal.
cover_service_channels.scope: Full rectangular external end, side and top wall witness solids contained in released cover. Split seam and cell-facing contact opening intentional; not a global dielectric rating.

handle_joint.working_screw: M4x16 pan head, nominal D8/H3.1; supplier dimensional-table tolerance screen, not hardware-lot qualification

supplier_dimension_evidence.scope: Parent-confirmed supplier dimensional tables, not inspected ISO primary standards.

handle_joint.engagement_scope: Screw covers the complete nut body even at minimum length; usable threads/chamfers and fully threaded supplier part require confirmation. Nut body height is not certified effective thread engagement.
handle_joint.M4x20_alternative: Not interchangeable: maximum tip z70.8 exceeds the current blind bore end z68 by2.8 mm; redesign/rebind before use.
handle_joint.load_path: Handle nut -> metal screw/washer -> integral shell crown; keyed shoulder resists rotation. Cartridge not a structural tie.
handle_joint.wood_option: Same original external turning silhouette; metal cross-dowel/insert and keyed interface require separate design. No wood pilot or plastic thread qualified.

front_skin.previous_defect: The curved original bezel was removed by rear loading cuts, exposing PCB edge; nominal nose cutter did not define the whole effective opening.
front_skin.construction: Same-color locally flat raised front skin, integral with carrier rails; source USB/PCB unchanged.
front_skin.pcb_concealment_scope: Full actual tongue-front X/Z projection has real1mm material ahead of it; horizontal -Y front view, not arbitrary oblique viewpoints.
front_skin.z_loading_proof: All actual PCBA material stays at least this distance rearward of the skin's rear plane for every pureZ translation, independently of height.

usb.plug_scope: Unselected 8.8x8x2.6 male nose only; final pose touches source mouth, not a mating-depth/overmold qualification.
usb.load_path: Carrier ledge/rails and keyed bezel react handling loads through carrier/front screws/shell, not a claim of solder-tail load capacity.
usb.tails: Through-board anchor height/real tails unmeasured; no invented occupied tail-height solid.

print_orientation.shell: Mouth down, handle up. One solid including three attachment lugs.
print_orientation.handle: Base down; sideways nut tunnel and closed crown require slicer support review.
print_orientation.supports: Upper internal crown slopes and nut-pocket roofs need explicit slicer support/bridging review. Mouth gives support-removal access BEFORE assembly. No universal support-free claim.

pcba_stl_scope.reason: Preserved thin T8 contacts have known fold-root mesh defects; no metal bridge added.

gates: No live cell, fabrication, purchase, child-use or print-strength approval.
Cell loaded geometry/contact forces, positive button, wrapper abrasion and contact insulation remain unqualified.
Speaker rim, terminals, wire routing, cone excursion and acoustics remain unqualified.
Silk PLA finish is not creep, impact, thermal, dielectric or flame qualification.
Printed allowances are nominal CAD choices, not measured tolerances.
USB male nose is not a selected mating cable; no connector-tail height is inferred.
M2/M4 hardware dimensions, screw engagement, nut retention and torque require actual part/slicer/physical review.
Service paths are declared finite rigid poses, not an exhaustive continuous/deforming-motion proof.
Original photos/artwork are not imported or redistributed.
